data.title: Michael Saylor finally breaks silence on personal Bitcoin holdings
data.description: Billionaire Michael Saylor-led Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR) again sold Bitcoin (BTC) last week as the leading cryptocurrency's price failed to recover.
